name: Check which paste keys reach Rowbly in each terminal
description:
Part of the Epic `clipboard-image-attachments`; read its description first. This is a check: it produces findings, not code.

## Goal

Find out which paste keys reach Rowbly (Ink 8) in each common terminal, and what each terminal's own paste key sends when the clipboard holds **only an image**. The answers decide which keys the paste hook binds and what the user guide tells people.

## What to check

Use a throwaway Ink script that logs every `useInput` event (`input`, `key.ctrl`, `key.meta`) and every `usePaste` event (including empty ones). Put an image on the clipboard, then press:

- Ctrl+V
- Alt+V
- Ctrl+Alt+V
- the terminal's own paste key (Cmd+V, Ctrl+Shift+V, Shift+Insert, right click)

Terminals:

| OS | Terminals |
| --- | --- |
| macOS | Terminal.app, iTerm2, Ghostty, kitty, WezTerm |
| Windows | Windows Terminal, the VS Code terminal, conhost |
| Linux | GNOME Terminal, Konsole, kitty, Alacritty, Ghostty |

Test the VS Code terminal on all three OSes. Also note whether each terminal turns on bracketed paste when Ink asks for it.

## Done when

- A Comment on this Story holds a table: terminal × key → what Ink receives (`ctrl+v`, `meta+v`, `ctrl+meta+v`, empty paste, nothing, or the terminal pasted something itself).
- The Comment ends with a recommendation for the key set and the key hint on each platform. Default assumption: Ctrl+V, Alt+V and Ctrl+Alt+V, plus an empty bracketed paste where terminals send one.
- No repository files change, and no screenshots are committed.
